Former president Donald Trump, the 2024 Republican nominee for President of the United States, considered several prominent Republicans and other individuals before selecting Senator JD Vance of Ohio as his candidate for Vice President of the United States on July 15, 2024, the first day of the 2024 Republican National Convention.[1] At age 39, Vance formally won the vice presidential nomination.
The Trump–Vance ticket defeated the Harris–Walz ticket in the 2024 presidential election.
Vance became the youngest person elected vice president since Richard Nixon in 1952 at 40 years old.
On October 1, Vance and Tim Walz participated a 90-minute Vice Presidential debate hosted by CBS.
The debate was moderated by Margaret Brennan and Norah O'Donnell.
